description: Annual Bike Counts (Super Tuesday) is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. This dataset contains observed bike counts from sites across the city. These counts are often referred to "Super Tuesday" and is Australia’s biggest annual commuter bike count. The count also contains information for gender, and movement flow of people on bikes. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are bike count, infrastructure, safemobility, super tuesday, transport, travel. The portal shows 352 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
